requirements.details: The typical offer is BCC to BBC. The course lists a UCAS tariff of 112. Include a humanities A level assessed through essay writing.

requirements.label: Foundation Year tariff and A level
requirements.details: The Foundation Year table asks for 72 UCAS points overall, including an A level at grade D. The department also requires an essay-based humanities A level.

requirements.label: Subjects for the humanities A-level condition
requirements.details: Examples include History, Philosophy, Religious Studies, Classical Civilisation, English Language, English Literature and the combined English Language and Literature A level. This condition also applies when presenting BTEC or OCR qualifications.

requirements.label: Direct entry with BTEC or OCR
requirements.details: For a BTEC or OCR Cambridge Technical qualification, the table gives DMM alongside the humanities A-level subject condition.

requirements.label: Foundation Year with BTEC or OCR
requirements.details: The Foundation Year lists MMP for BTEC and OCR Cambridge Technical qualifications, alongside the humanities A-level subject condition.

requirements.label: Access to HE Diploma for direct entry
requirements.details: Earn 45 Level 3 credits, including 30 at Merit or higher. The diploma must cover a relevant humanities subject at Level 3.

requirements.label: Access qualification for the Foundation Year
requirements.details: Pass overall with English or an alternative humanities subject listed in the course table.

requirements.details: Irish Higher grades H3/H3/H3/H3/H4 must include English at H3. Scottish Highers require BBBB including English. The English subject may be Language, Literature or combined Language and Literature.

requirements.label: Mixed qualifications and additional A levels

requirements.label: US high school route to the Foundation Year
requirements.details: A US high school diploma with GPA 2.5 or above meets the general academic threshold for foundation entry. Check the additional conditions of the chosen course.

source.title: Chester · United States · academic entry by level

requirements.label: US diploma route to Year 1 (Level 4)
requirements.details: A US high school diploma with GPA 3.5 satisfies the general academic route on its own. Alternatively, a diploma or equivalent with GPA 3.0 needs one of the listed test, class or college options. Course-specific conditions also apply.

source.title: Chester · United States · academic entry by level

requirements.label: US diploma plus AP exams or high school classes
requirements.details: For the GPA 3.0 diploma route, one option is two relevant AP exams, each at grade 3 or higher. Another option is two high school Honours or AP classes graded B. Either option supplies the additional qualification for Year 1.

source.title: Chester · United States · academic entry by level

requirements.label: US diploma plus college study
requirements.details: Applicants using the GPA 3.0 diploma route can qualify for Year 1 with two college-level classes graded B, or two semesters of community college at B.

source.title: Chester · United States · academic entry by level

requirements.label: US diploma plus ACT or pre-March 2016 SAT
requirements.details: For Year 1 with the GPA 3.0 diploma route, Chester accepts an ACT composite of 22 or an SAT total of 1500 from before March 2016 covering reading, writing and mathematics.

source.title: Chester · United States · academic entry by level

requirements.label: US diploma plus SAT taken after March 2016
requirements.details: For the GPA 3.0 diploma route Chester gives an overall SAT of 1090 and describes a 550 condition for reading/writing and math. The wording leaves the section thresholds unclear. Confirm the combination with admissions.

source.title: Chester · United States · academic entry by level

requirements.label: IB English as language evidence
requirements.details: For undergraduate language proficiency the international table accepts English A or B at Higher Level with grade 4, or English B at Standard Level with grade 5. Course-specific academic subject conditions also apply.

source.title: Chester · International entry requirements · undergraduate qualifications

requirements.label: IELTS Academic formats
requirements.details: IELTS Academic, including One Skill Retake, and IELTS for UKVI Academic require 6.0 overall and 5.5 per skill. IELTS Online uses those scores and is limited to nationals covered by the UKVI differential evidence requirement.

source.title: Chester · International entry requirements · undergraduate qualifications

requirements.label: Pearson English tests
requirements.details: PTE Academic and PTE Academic UKVI require 59 overall and in each skill. Chester excludes the online version of PTE Academic.

source.title: Chester · International entry requirements · undergraduate qualifications

requirements.label: Duolingo English Test
requirements.details: Applicants of nationalities covered by the UKVI differential evidence requirement may present 105 overall with at least 100 in every band.

source.title: Chester · International entry requirements · undergraduate qualifications

requirements.label: TOEFL iBT by test date
requirements.details: Before 21 January 2026 the iBT or At Home table gives 79 overall with reading 18, listening 17, speaking 20 and writing 17. After that date the iBT table asks for 4 overall and 4 in every skill. Chester excludes MyBest scores. The source does not assign tests taken on the changeover date to either row.

source.title: Chester · International entry requirements · undergraduate qualifications

requirements.label: Trinity ISE II by test date
requirements.details: Chester lists Merit in each of four components for tests before April 2026. Its row for tests after April 2027 gives 90 overall with 80 per skill. Confirm the intervening period with admissions.

source.title: Chester · International entry requirements · undergraduate qualifications

requirements.label: LanguageCert Academic and SELT
requirements.details: The undergraduate threshold is 65 overall and 60 per band. The SELT option excludes online tests. The separate Academic Online option is available to nationals covered by UKVI differential evidence rules.

source.title: Chester · International entry requirements · undergraduate qualifications

requirements.label: Skills for English UKVI
requirements.details: Chester accepts a B2 Pass on the Skills for English UKVI test.

source.title: Chester · International entry requirements · undergraduate qualifications

requirements.label: School and Cambridge English evidence
requirements.details: Accepted alternatives include GCSE or IGCSE English Language at C, OxfordAQA GCSE at 4, Gatehouse International ESOL Level 1 Merit, AES Bellerbys Foundation at 50%, or Cambridge B2 First grade B overall.

source.title: Chester · International entry requirements · undergraduate qualifications

requirements.label: Password and Kaplan English tests
requirements.details: Password Skills Plus At-home requires 6.0 overall and 5.5 per band. Kaplan Test of English requires 444 overall with 425 or higher in each component.

source.title: Chester · International entry requirements · undergraduate qualifications

requirements.label: Evidence for applicants from majority English-speaking countries
requirements.details: The university normally waives further evidence of English proficiency for applicants from its listed majority English-speaking countries, including the United States. Course academic qualifications are assessed separately.
